content.comment_body: Hello, I have two questions: 1. How many [product_name] analog RTD modules can be connected to a [product_name] base unit? 2. Is there any alternative way to connect more PT100 sensors to [product_name] besides the [product_name] analog RTD module?

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. The latest [product_name] base unit with [version_no] supports up to 8 analog inputs. If you use all of them for PT100 sensors, you can connect 4 [product_name] analog RTD modules, as each module offers two channels for PT100. If you need to use more RTD modules, you would have to use multiple base units and connect them via Ethernet.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users want to increase PT100 sensor connectivity using [product_name] modules. There is uncertainty regarding the maximum number of expansion modules allowed and alternative solutions when limits are reached. Advice was provided about analog input capacity, module limitation, and linking several base units through a network.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping to connect a higher quantity of PT100 sensors, either by utilizing all expansion module slots or by finding alternate connection methods through multiple base units, and they want to know the supported limits and possible workarounds.
